entries.title: Isaiah 24:1
segments: ¶Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof. {turneth...: Heb. perverteth the face thereof}

words.text: thereof. {turneth...: Heb. perverteth the face thereof}

entries.title: Isaiah 24:2
segments: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him. {priest: or, prince}

words.text: And it shall be, as with the people
; as with the taker of usury

entries.title: Isaiah 24:3
segments: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:4
segments: The earth mourneth [and] fadeth away, the world languisheth [and] fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish. {the haughty...: Heb. the height of the people}

words.text: . {the haughty...: Heb. the height of the people}

entries.title: Isaiah 24:5
segments: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:6
segments: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:7
segments: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:8
segments: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:9
segments: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:10
segments: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

words.text: , that no man may come in

entries.title: Isaiah 24:11
segments: [There is] a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:12
segments: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:13
segments: ¶When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, [there shall be] as the shaking of an olive tree, [and] as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

words.text: ¶When thus it shall be in the midst

entries.title: Isaiah 24:14
segments: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:15
segments: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, [even] the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea. {fires: or, valleys}

entries.title: Isaiah 24:16
segments: ¶From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, [even] glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously. {uttermost...: Heb. wing} {My leanness: Heb. Leanness to me, or, My secret to me}

words.text: . {uttermost...: Heb. wing} {My leanness: Heb. Leanness to me, or, My secret to me}

entries.title: Isaiah 24:17
segments: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, [are] upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:18
segments: And it shall come to pass, [that] he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

words.text: And it shall come to pass, [that] he who fleeth

entries.title: Isaiah 24:19
segments: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:20
segments: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

words.text: upon it; and it shall fall

entries.title: Isaiah 24:21
segments: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones [that are] on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth. {punish: Heb. visit upon}

words.text: And it shall come to pass in that day

entries.title: Isaiah 24:22
segments: And they shall be gathered together, [as] prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited. {as prisoners...: Heb. with the gathering of prisoners} {pit: or, dungeon} {visited: or, found wanting}

words.text: And they shall be gathered together
. {as prisoners...: Heb. with the gathering of prisoners} {pit: or, dungeon} {visited: or, found wanting}

entries.title: Isaiah 24:23
segments: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously. {before...: or, there shall be glory before his ancients}

words.text: . {before...: or, there shall be glory before his ancients}
